chains.name: Ethereum
chains.detail: PQC in 'The Splurge' roadmap. Dedicated PQ team formed Jan 2026. leanVM development underway.
chains.exposure: All historical public keys visible on-chain

chains.name: Bitcoin
chains.detail: BIP-360 (P2QRH, ML-DSA-based output type) merged as a draft Feb 2026; no activation plan or date. Hash-based address types (P2PKH/P2WPKH) protect unspent outputs until first spend; Taproot (P2TR) outputs expose the key on-chain. Oct 2026: Justin Drake's 'bunker mode' call urges migrating exposed-key funds to fresh hash-protected addresses.
chains.exposure: ~6-6.9M BTC (~31% of supply) behind exposed public keys — reused addresses, spent-from addresses, P2PK, and Taproot (CoinDesk, Europol, Oct 2026)

chains.name: Solana

chains.name: Algorand

chains.exposure: Partial — state proofs are PQ-secure, transaction sigs are not
watch: Full transaction signature migration to PQC
